locationMethod: Original TEI pb/cb/lb markers; source location alone is not image verification
reviewMethod: AI visual readings with explicit uncertainty; no automatic textual, pointing or morphological changes

limitations: AI visual review, no independent expert certification.
The 1593×1943 JPEG permits many consonants to be read, but does not support reliable complete pointing on most wordforms.
Most readings intentionally contain consonants only or partial pointing and remain uncertain. They must not be used as automatic pointing donors.
Bboxes describe complete line regions in the unmodified original, not exact word boundaries.
Existing Digital Mishnah and Be’eri texts, all points and morphological candidates remain unchanged.
AI visual review of the original JPEG and lossless crop/nearest-neighbor inspection, not full human manuscript certification. Original image unchanged.
All 45 running-text lines plus the separate chapter heading were inspected. Only physically visible words from 1:5#11 through 2:6#1 are included; earlier 1:5 and later 2:6 belong to adjoining pages.
Readings with status uncertain are partial visual transcriptions. Omitted fine points in such readings are not certified absent; no vowel was supplied from Be’eri or Accordance for this review.

The JPEG resolves consonants better than every fine vowel/dagesh/shin mark. Especially the faded outer-margin words, compact abbreviation signs, dark patches, and the explicitly marked □ remain uncertain.
The margin text and short terminal letter fragments are recorded without identifying a scribal hand or silently assigning them to a base hand.

Word המקרא crosses right lines9–10 and is represented once, under the first line. Two marginal words are listed under right line7 with positional notes; their small faint marks are not readable enough for a complete vowel claim.

AI visual review, not a claim of complete human manuscript verification. Original JPEG and all six lossless nearest-neighbor column crops were inspected; additional lossless crops covered the right margin and correction regions.

All 23 main lines in each column were inspected. Transcriptions and uncertain word readings are partial observations: unrecorded vowel, dagesh and shin/sin marks are unresolved, not certified absent. No Be’eri or Accordance pointing was used as manuscript evidence.
The image begins with הראשון in 2:6; רחץ בלילה is on the preceding folio and is deliberately not recorded here. The image ends with ושלמוספים in 4:1; later words of that unit are not on this page.
Fine pointing is often faint or merges with letter strokes, parchment texture, a vertical crease, or correction ink. Uncertain records are not suitable as fully verified pointed replacements.

Main-line numbering includes lines containing chapter/mishnah headings. Margin additions are attached to the closest main-line number and explicitly described; no assignment to original or correcting hands is attempted.
AI-Bildprüfung des ganzen Blattes, keine Behauptung vollständiger menschlicher Handschriftenverifikation.
Unsichere Lesungen sind partielle Beobachtungen: ausgelassene Vokal- oder Dageschzeichen bedeuten NICHT, dass diese im Manuskript fehlen.
Feine Punkte, Abkürzungszeichen und blasse Randnachträge sind teilweise nicht eindeutig; weder Beeri- noch Accordance-Vokale wurden ergänzt.
Zeilenzählung umfasst die kurze Kapitelüberschrift links als Zeile 5; Kapitel-/Abschnittszeichen innerhalb einer Zeile sind keine Mischna-Wörter.

Die 222 unsicheren Wortlesungen sind keine freigegebenen vollständigen Vokalisierungen; nur 55 ausdrücklich klare Lesungen wurden als clear bezeichnet. Unaufgelöste Punkte müssen am Original nachgeprüft werden.

Acht Stellen des Gesamtprojekts erhielten eine unabhängige Gegenlesung. Betroffene zunächst klare Lesungen sind hier wegen unvollständiger Zeichenfreigabe bzw. Widerspruch ausdrücklich unsicher; Erstlesungen bleiben dokumentiert.
AI visual review of the original JPEG and lossless nearest-neighbor inspection crops; no claim of complete human manuscript verification.
Faint points and points touching thick letter strokes are retained as uncertain, not treated as absent. Partial pointed readings do not reconstruct missing marks.
Only words physically on 003v are included: beginning at 5:4 wordIndex 11, ending at 6:7 wordIndex 4. Headings and marginal material are explicit.

Separate diplomatic indices that split one manuscript word are flagged explicitly (ה/יא, של/יח, י/הודה, גידול/יו, לפני/ו, הפרפר/יות). Word-record count is therefore not a count of distinct ink-separated words.

AI visual review for human inspection; no claim of complete human manuscript verification. Original JPEG, all six full-column lossless crops and eleven additional close crops inspected.
Every physically present aligned diplomatic position is recorded, including positions whose candidate pointing agreed elsewhere. No Be’eri or Accordance reading was used to transcribe this image.

Uncertain readings are observed partial pointing, not complete normalized vocalizations. Unwritten vowels are not inferred; the absence of an untranscribed weak dot is not asserted. Close combinations of dagesh/rafe, vocalic dots and pen/scan specks often prevent a full certification.
Column/line numbers refer to 26 main text lines in each column. Chapter/mishnah labels and the ornamental chapter division are noted separately; no attribution of correcting hands is attempted.
The page begins inside 6:7, at diplomatic word 5 עמו, and ends inside 7:5, after word 34 ר'. Other words of these units are on adjacent folios and are not assigned records here.
Source token splits וה/וא, של/ש and אי/ן do not denote separate clearly isolated manuscript words; their fragment records explicitly preserve this alignment limitation.

Konsonantengerüst und Abkürzungen direkt gelesen. Die zahlreichen schwachen bzw. mit Strichen verschmelzenden Vokalzeichen sind in diesem Durchgang nicht vollständig aufgelöst: unpunktierte readings sind ausdrücklich Teilablesungen, keine Behauptung fehlender Punktierung.
Zeilen-bbox umfasst die ganze Schriftzeile, keine Einzelwort-Lokalisierung. Handzuweisungen werden nicht vorgenommen.
Dies ist noch keine abgeschlossene Kollation der vollständigen Vokalisation: die gespeicherten Wörter bleiben uncertain, bis die offenen Einzelzeichen geprüft sind.
